data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 was GBP 296.8m. The report states that prior-year claims reserves showed a net decrease of GBP 2.3m, a release driven by favourable claims development primarily relating to reserve releases for the 2017 hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria. The report provides a gross claims development triangle but does not explicitly state a gross prior-year movement, so the quantified prior-year movement used here is the explicitly stated net decrease of GBP 2.3m.
raw_causal_phrases: Losses and loss adjustment expenses are GBP 10.1m lower than in 2017 resulting in a decrease in the loss ratio from 70.7% to 56.9%. The main driver for the decrease is due to release of reserves in the period, in respect of the three hurricanes, Harvey, Irma and Maria.
The movement in prior year's provisions for net claims outstanding was a decrease of GBP 2.3 million.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening reserves (claims outstanding) taken from Balance Sheet (gross). The note in the accounts explicitly states a prior-year movement but only gives a NET decrease of GBP 2.3m; a gross prior-year movement figure is not explicitly stated. A gross claims development triangle is present (note 13) but extraction of a complete, unambiguous gross prior-year movement from the printed triangle was uncertain from the images; therefore the reported prior-year movement uses the explicitly stated NET figure (last-resort fallback). The triangle was partially transcribed and retained in _claims_triangle but some development-period cells could not be read with confidence.
